description: This file defines the class SugarWidgetFieldVarchar, a widget for handling varchar fields in SugarCRM/SuiteCRM reports and UI, including methods for building query filters and displaying input fields.

classes.name: SugarWidgetFieldVarchar
classes.description: A widget class for varchar fields in reports, providing filter query methods and input display.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor accepting a layout manager reference, calls parent constructor.

methods.name: queryFilterEquals
methods.description: Builds a SQL condition for equality filter on the varchar field.

methods.name: queryFilterNot_Equals_Str
methods.description: Builds a SQL condition for inequality filter on the varchar field.

methods.name: queryFilterContains
methods.description: Builds a SQL condition for a LIKE '%value%' filter.

methods.name: queryFilterdoes_not_contain
methods.description: Builds a SQL condition for a NOT LIKE '%value%' filter.

methods.name: queryFilterStarts_With
methods.description: Builds a SQL condition for a LIKE 'value%' filter.

methods.name: queryFilterEnds_With
methods.description: Builds a SQL condition for a LIKE '%value' filter.

methods.name: queryFilterone_of
methods.description: Builds a SQL IN clause for multiple values, quoting each.

methods.name: displayInput
methods.description: Returns HTML input field for editing the varchar value.
